contract: ADR 131, NR-04 ordinary Goal tool read. ADRs 35, 41, 55, 57, 65, 116 and 129–130 also apply.

baseline.legacy: Actual TUI bridge creates a canonical plan and returns its list and detail. Fixture generation compares the real manifest, list and detail. The excluded internal run trace has a random event ID.
baseline.native: Three public tests against the extracted b6f58fef predecessor stop at the first actual model request with tool_not_projected.
baseline.firstCandidateRun: Seven pass and one fails. The large-result test expected a nested output field for the flattened artifact-reference wire shape. The harness was corrected to check the actual top-level ref and request fixed windows, with the saved-source mutation assertion retained.

ordinaryPublicSurface: The actual --tools intersection leaves precisely the TS goal_get_plan schema in Plan mode. Current-conversation list and explicit detail preserve canonical task identities, status and success criteria from the real old store.

The latest runner-progress changes the displayed status without changing plan-body bytes. A stale cancelled index entry is filtered. Foreign and missing IDs return the same empty explicit result. Private trace and unknown task fields stay out of the model response.
An absent index produces an empty list. Corrupt or oversized sources yield explicit failure. Original Tool Result, live Grant, Evidence and settled conversation are present.
Ordinary chat reads a larger Goal observation back in windows from the original immutable Tool Result even after the actual plan body changes.

wholePackagedChangeStack.coverage: Bounded compaction and its fallback, legacy settings, Goal intake and reads, and the original delegated foreground shell from the same extracted featureless binaries.

limits: Isolated candidate and loopback model. Goal plan creation, updating, Explorer execution, installed-host stop, production model and whole P4 acceptance remain open.
